notes: The Beth-jeshimoth name is split across its two source tokens, with the chain's relational *to* placed on the first; keeping the name as one two-token unit was the competing reading.
The appositional *even* before *the Salt Sea* stands on a phrase no object marker marks and no waw precedes, so it is `added` under rule 16.
*the slopes of Pisgah* is rule 29's fronting case — the rectum's article takes the phrase's single *the* while the ASV renders `פִּסְגָּה` anarthrously.
